title: corpus/1 — the frozen inputs of the M5 vertical and production's outputs for them (docs/specs/m5.md §3)
description: Everything here is a name or a content address: no Renavon bytes are carried inline, and the store that resolves the refs lives beside this record outside the repository. `authorisation` names the owner-signed decision record that opened Tier-C door renavon-first-contact; L5.8 verifies it. `pipeline` is the vertical's MODULE:CALLABLE, the operator's code, as `tannen run` names it.
